notes: Face expression presets for the comm feed (MODELING 4.4). Each preset sets shape-key weights 0..1; keys left out are 0. Neutral must stay all 0 (the approved face). Values are the combinations used in the gate-2 review (REVIEW_MODELS G2-03). blink, mouth_open and mouth_o are also driven by the blink timer and lip-flap on top of these.
